Welcome to Dog Rescue Channel!

We will upload stories of rescued animals and we hope all videos will be inspirational stories, we always try to help animals from wild, homeless, abandoned, abused or from difficult situations to give them a better life and love.

God bless all rescuers and all those who always save animals from any situation.
